change.source: finding 1 (a signal to the bridge during a post leaves the connectors child running): the bridge starts the child while it holds a slot the signal path reads; on SIGINT and SIGTERM the signal path ends the child, waits for it, and then ends the bridge (cases a_signal_to_the_bridge_leaves_no_connectors_child_running and a_signal_during_a_post_ends_the_connectors_child_with_the_bridge; mutant m16 red); a bridge ended by SIGKILL still leaves a running child, named in docs/design/bridge.md and on the limits page; the next bridge posts with the same key, which connectors answers as a replay
